title: Refactoring targets report
summary: Turns CodeScene's uplift targets into a prioritized refactoring backlog: why each file, where to start, who to involve, the risks to plan for, the estimated outcome, and a refactoring spec to hand to a coding agent.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.description: The CodeScene project to report on. Find it with list_projects.

inputs.name: target_code_health
inputs.description: The Code Health to refactor each target to, from 1.0 to 10.0.

inputs.name: max_targets
inputs.description: The maximum number of uplift targets in the report.

inputs.name: include_local_targets
inputs.description: Whether to include local targets, the best candidates within each architectural component.
